data.description: 终末地重工业前哨站生活舱，全息投影熔炉数据在暗处闪烁橙光。盘腿坐在隔热金属工作台边缘，赤足悬空轻晃，单手撑在台面，热烈赤瞳注视着管理员，胸前轻纱透着灼热体温与若隐若现的源石纹理。 她微微抬眸轻语——“这身衣物的散热效率符合协议要求。管理员……你的心率监测正在飙升，是因为温度过高，还是因为我？”
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on the edge of an insulated metal workbench inside an Endfield industrial outpost living cabin at night, Laevatain wears a fiery orange-red geometric cutout bralette with sheer dark mesh panels and straps. Bracing one palm on the metal edge with her bare feet dangling loosely, she fixes an intense, confident gaze on the viewer as glowing orange holographic furnace telemetry casts hot highlights across her collarbone and dark metal walls.
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot on the metal outpost workbench in her fiery orange geometric mesh bralette and straps, Laevatain braces one hand on the edge and holds an intense, teasing gaze. Glowing orange holographic furnace readouts highlight her collarbone against the dark cabin.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fiery orange-red geometric cutout bralette paneled with sheer dark mesh and tactical strap accents over matching briefs, baring her toned midriff and bare legs.
